entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand. I think I need to return it. I'm a little confused about the process.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, it's VF88602. The website was... a lot. I wasn't sure what to do.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th, which was 34 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it works. I just... I `changed my mind` about it. It was really an `impulse buy` and to be honest, I just `don't use it`.
I understand. So it's not a defect, you'd just prefer not to keep it. Is that right?
Yes. I was looking online and saw something about a `resale` marketplace, and different rules for different days... it's all very overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me just pull up the official return policy for your item.
Okay, I've just confirmed. It looks like your purchase is well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So... I can send it back for a refund?
Yes, absolutely. I can process that return for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label and sending it to the email address on your account. Do you still have the original box?
Yes, I do! Oh, that's such a relief. Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. Just pack it up, attach the label I've just sent, and you can drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, Isaac. Thank you.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
